viewportMatrix.design: Full 16-row Cartesian product of width 390/768 × height 844/1024 × color scheme light/dark × root-font-scale 1x/2x; every screen/theme/font-size tuple is present. All primary rows use desktop input emulation (hasTouch=false, isMobile=false).

integrity.browserProfile: fresh Playwright-owned temporary profile; no personal profile or tabs accessed

scope.tested: Full 16-row viewport matrix: width 390/768 × height 844/1024 × light/dark × root font scale 1x/2x, each row captured independently with hasTouch=false and isMobile=false; common matchMedia serialization and matches for viewport width/height in px, em and rem; orientation; aspect ratio; resolution; preferred color scheme; reduced motion; pointer/hover and any-pointer/any-hover; screen/print; only/not/comma/and/or media queries; unknown media feature/type negation; invalid-query behavior; CSS @media custom-property status; viewport swap/reverse resize and MQL onchange/addListener/removeListener/addEventListener; event readonly fields and final matches visibility during updates; color-scheme/reduced-motion emulation; 2x/3x device scale factors; four touch input supplement rows (phone/tablet × light/dark) with hasTouch=true and isMobile=false.
scope.notTested: Container queries, print pagination/layout, browser zoom, platform accessibility font scaling, user stylesheet overrides, real hardware input devices, actual display color calibration, fullscreen, embedded webviews, and other Chromium versions.
scope.transport: Synthetic HTML is served only from a Node server bound to 127.0.0.1. Page routing permits only that exact ephemeral origin. The browser proxy binds to 127.0.0.1 and rejects every request without forwarding. Browser background networking is disabled. No external requests or TLS are used.
